$m=$

{{field-1}}" :question/worked-solution "Let $f(x)=2 x^{4} -5 x^{3} -6 x^{2} -\frac{1}{x}.$ The slope of the tangent at $x=4$ is equal to $f^{\prime}(4).$ Computing the derivative, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}f^{\prime}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2 x^{4} -5 x^{3} -6 x^{2} -\frac{1}{x}) \\ & =2\cdot4x^{3}-5\cdot3x^{2}-6\cdot2x+x^{-2} \\ & =8 x^{3} -15 x^{2} -12 x + \frac{1}{x^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we evaluate at $x=4$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}f^{\prime}(4) & =8 (4)^{3} -15 (4)^{2} -12 (4) + \frac{1}{(4)^{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{16}-240-48+512 \\ & =224+\frac{1}{16} \\ & =\frac{3585}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
m=f^{\prime}(4)=\frac{3585}{16}.
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["dbcf1c49-7241-5d03-94fd-bfa2c1d44ecf"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "d1b31040-b524-59d5-8126-81e48308a905" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186064342.py"} [:db/add 17592186064342 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186064342 :knowledge-point/questions ["75d5858a-47f7-5c0c-b41e-cfdd00aba409" "689248f2-21f8-5d24-90d8-7ca8fd740f53" "16c505e0-5d29-5749-bc56-753e338dddc8" "b38d997b-b6bd-5955-ad93-8d9cd05fb5df" "23f74b85-e755-53c7-b42c-a010cf3710be" "5280129d-18fb-5b8f-bb02-d86a2b5535fa"]} [:db/ensure 17592186064342 :knowledge-point/validate]]
